ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the figure there is a horizontal number line, with tick marks arranged at equal intervals. The tick marked 0 is on the left side; counting to the right from 0, the tick after the third equal interval is marked y; continuing to the right, the tick marked 20 is located at the 5th equal interval to the right of 0. Reasoning: Because 0 to 20 spans 5 equal tick intervals, each interval represents 20 ÷ 5 = 4. y is at the 3rd interval to the right of 0, so y = 3 × 4 = 12.
